tools.name: ask
tools.description: Grounded natural-language answer over the chinaready.co corpus (retrieval + generation), with the source articles attached as citations. Replies in English. Falls back to a contact suggestion when no page matches confidently.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Semantic + keyword search over chinaready.co guides, services, and FAQ. Returns ranked excerpts whose source headers carry absolute chinaready.co URLs to cite.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the China market-entry topics the chinaready.co corpus covers, with example queries and hub page paths for each.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch a chinaready.co page as clean Markdown (site pages only). Use paths returned by search/list_topics, e.g. "/insights/china-icp-and-psb-filing-explained/".

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
